calculator_engine: function maxDrawdown(values){let peak=values[0];let maxDD=0;let troughVal=peak;for(const v of values){if(v>peak)peak=v;const dd=(peak-v)/peak;if(dd>maxDD){maxDD=dd;troughVal=v;}}return{maxDrawdown:(maxDD*100).toFixed(2),peak,trough:troughVal};}
